title: Oblique Collision Rebound Angle and Velocity Relations
latex: \tan\beta = e \tan\alpha, \quad v_t = u_t, \quad v_n = e u_n

variables.\\beta: Angle of rebound with common normal
variables.\\alpha: Angle of incidence with common normal
variables.v_t, u_t: Tangential velocities before and after impact
variables.v_n, u_n: Normal velocities before and after impact

assumptions: Line of impact along common normal
validity_conditions: Valid for oblique impact against stationary smooth barrier or sphere
common_misuse: Measuring angles from tangent surface instead of normal
Assuming tangential velocity changes without friction
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 172; HRW Ch 9 p. 251
